title: AnomalyDecisionV1
description: V1 data contract for detector anomaly decisions. score >= threshold implies ANOMALY; score < threshold implies NORMAL. INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE requires null score and threshold and explanatory reason codes without implying health or completed diagnosis.

decision_id.description: Nonempty unique identifier for this decision.

recording_ref.description: Nonempty identifier referencing the analyzed recording.

detector_id.description: Nonempty identifier of the detector model or algorithm.

detector_version.description: Nonempty version string of the detector.

execution_environment.description: Execution environment target. Restricted to 'HOST_CPU' because embedded silicon acceleration has not been measured.

quality_status.description: Quality assessment of input data and processing. NORMAL and ANOMALY require 'PASS'.

reason_codes.description: List of diagnostic reason codes. Mandatory when outcome is INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE.

score.description: Finite numerical anomaly score, or null if outcome is INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE.

threshold.description: Finite numerical decision threshold, or null if outcome is INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE.
